description.content:
A generic text-generation interface to external LLM providers and Pryon-hosted LLMs.
 implements a subset of the OpenAI /v1/chat/completions API specification
 as defined here: https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat
 Using the official OpenAI client SDK for your language is recommended.
 The following providers are supported currently:
 - pryon
 - openai
 - anthropic
 - vertex ai
 Please check the respective provider's documentation
 for supported text-generation models and accepted sampling params.
 If streaming is enabled, responses will follow the SSE standard
 https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#server-sent-events.
